recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17256 unless the work group reopens conditional PATCH matching or error semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17256 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked the HTTP PATCH section to document conditional PATCH expectations instead of implying that conditional PATCH works exactly like Conditional Update; the accepted behavior was no create on no match, patch on one match, and an error on multiple matches.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 051eb59d8749d2453417410ed7d2d55ec1f19a1a, svn revision 14206, which removed the incorrect Conditional Update equivalence wording and added a conditional patch subsection with no-match, one-match, and multiple-match outcomes.
additional_context: source/http.html is an active RESTful API page in source/hierarchy.xml. Later adjacent issues FHIR-31610 and FHIR-49646 corrected terminology and URL-pattern details and are already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-23077 and FHIR-17806 are related but separate CapabilityStatement and transaction questions, also already represented. FHIR-16448 was co-applied historically but concerns conditional-operation standards status and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current combined source/http.html includes the Conditional patch URL, the SHOULD support rule for servers supporting PATCH and Conditional Update, and the expected 404, update, and 412 outcomes for zero, one, and multiple matches.
